title: A Day Behind the Kiosk Counter
paras: Mara Chen opened her coastal-town newspaper kiosk at six each morning. One damp Tuesday, her daughter Lin came to help before school. While sweeping a cigarette [[butt|butt]] from beneath the counter, Lin noticed that two pictures had fallen from the wall. She put them back: a photograph of the state [[governor|governor]] buying a paper, and a larger portrait of singer Tomas Vale, her mother’s [[idol|idol]].

Business was slow at first. Mara threaded a blue glass [[bead|bead]] onto a customer’s broken necklace; jewellery repairs brought in extra money. Lin worked on her English homework beside her. Asked for an [[antonym|antonym]] of “open”, she glanced at the reversible door sign and wrote “closed”. Then a child arrived with his father, and Mara showed him how to [[spin|spin]] a wooden top while his father chose a newspaper.

Soon factory workers crowded the counter. Lin had expected the evening to be busier, but Mara explained that morning [[versus|versus]] evening sales varied with the factory timetable. Their earnings were [[dependent|dependent]] on when workers passed the kiosk, not simply on how long it stayed open. Lin put her homework away and helped count change.

After the queue cleared, Mara checked the papers. Coastal [[humidity|humidity]] could curl their edges, and the damage to the exposed copies was already [[noticeable|noticeable]]. She kept spare newspapers in a tightly closed wooden chest. Before Lin left for school, Mara asked her to shut its lid properly.
zh: 玛拉·陈每天早上六点打开海滨小镇上的报刊亭。一个潮湿的星期二，她的女儿琳上学前来帮忙。琳从柜台下扫出一枚烟蒂时，发现墙上掉下了两张照片。她把照片重新挂好：一张是州长买报纸的照片，另一张更大的肖像照上是歌手托马斯·韦尔，他是母亲的偶像。
起初生意清淡。玛拉把一颗蓝色玻璃珠穿到顾客断了的项链上；修补首饰能带来额外收入。琳在旁边做英语作业。题目要求写出“open”的反义词，她看了看可以翻面的门牌，写下了“closed”。随后，一个孩子和父亲来到报刊亭。父亲挑选报纸时，玛拉教孩子怎样让木陀螺转起来。
很快，工厂的工人挤满了柜台前。琳原以为傍晚会更忙，但玛拉解释说，早晨与傍晚的销售情况会随着工厂的作息时间而变化。她们的收入取决于工人何时经过报刊亭，而不只是营业时间有多长。琳收起作业，帮忙数零钱。
队伍散去后，玛拉检查了报纸。海边的湿气可能使报纸边缘卷曲，而摆在外面的那些报纸已经有了明显的损坏。她把备用报纸存放在盖紧的木箱里。琳去上学前，玛拉请她把箱盖盖好。

q.s: Newspapers were delivered to Mara’s kiosk before six each morning.
q.why: 文中只说明营业时间，未说明送报时间。

q.s: The governor’s photograph is larger than the singer’s portrait.
q.why: 文中明确说歌手的肖像照更大。

q.s: Mara kept spare newspapers in a tightly closed wooden chest.
q.why: 末段明确说明备用报纸存放在盖紧的木箱里。
